title: Correct architecture and delivery documentation
description: Bring the repository documentation into line with the audited implementation state from ERP-006 through ERP-010. Update technical structure, database design, PI/Quotation implementation status, deployment delivery notes, menu blueprint completion markers and automation-control documentation. Do not change business behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Technical documentation reflects the current source/test/.ai/scripts structure and delivered modules.
Quotation/PI design documentation clearly distinguishes implemented, deferred-browser and still-missing items.
Deployment and menu planning documents no longer list already completed ERP-007/008/009 functionality as future work.
Database design documentation includes the audited tables/columns added in recent phases without inventing production migration claims.
Cross-document task IDs and dependencies are internally consistent, including ERP-009 inventory completion and the rolling-queue protocol.
